entries.label: SORRY_ABOUT_THAT
entries.body:
Attention big, mean, hostile alien vessel hovering overhead in an obvious attack posture:
This is Spathi Captain Fwiffo.
I know you are going to torture me, so let's just get this over with right now.
The coordinates of my homeworld, Spathiwa, are 241.6, 368.7
and the ultra-secret Spathi Cypher, which is known only by me and several billion other Spathi
is `Huffi-Muffi-Guffi'.
Sorry about that little mistake with your landing vehicle!
I was so startled when it approached my vessel in a threatening manner that
er
my automated defense systems fired on it when it got too close.
I hope nobody got hurt!

entries.translation:
頭頂上那艘顯然擺出攻擊架 勢、又大又兇又充滿敵意的 外星船艦請注意：
我是斯帕西的菲弗船長。
我知道你們打算折磨我， 所以現在就趕快把事情辦完 吧。
我的母星斯帕西瓦座標是 241.6, 368.7
而只有我和另外幾十億名斯 帕西知道的最高機密斯帕西 密碼
是 `Huffi-Muffi -Guffi'。
很抱歉剛才誤傷了你們的登 陸艇！
它用威脅性的方式接近我的 船，實在把我嚇了一大跳， 所以
呃
它靠得太近時， 我的自動防禦系統就開火 了。
希望沒有人受傷！

entries.label: identify
entries.body: Attention alien vessel: Identify yourself or be destroyed!
entries.source: Attention alien vessel: Identify yourself or be destroyed!
entries.translation: 外星船艦請注意： 表明身分，否則格殺勿論！

entries.label: I_FWIFFO
entries.body:
Of course, of course!
As I said, I am Captain Fwiffo of the Spathi voidship StarRunner.
Our sensors have tracked your entry into this system
which you are no doubt here to conquer
and while you are certainly welcome to do so we would be greatly appreciative
if you would please just go away and forget this star system ever existed.
If you don't go, it will greatly complicate our master-slave relationship with the Ur-Quan
who stationed us here to watch over the Earthlings.

entries.translation:
當然，當然！
就像我說的，我是斯帕西虛 空船「逐星者號」的菲弗船 長。
我們的感測器追蹤到你們進 入這個星系
而你們來這裡無疑是為了征 服它
你們當然非常歡迎這麼做， 但若能就此離開
並忘記這個星系曾經存在， 我們會感激不盡。
如果你們不走， 我們和烏爾關之間的主奴關 係就會變得非常複雜
因為他們派我們留在這裡監 視地球人。

entries.label: hi_there
entries.body: Hi there friend! We come in peace and mean you no harm.
entries.source: Hi there friend! We come in peace and mean you no harm.
entries.translation: 嗨，朋友！我們為和平而 來，無意傷害你。

entries.label: ARE_YOU_SURE
entries.body:
Are you sure?
Because your statement is often just a more polite way of saying
`Attention alien vessel: Identify yourself or be destroyed.'
In any event, I am Spathi Captain Fwiffo of the voidship StarRunner
placed here in this planetary system as part of the powerful Earthguard star force
which our masters the Ur-Quan established here to make sure the Earthlings don't do anything tricky.

entries.translation:
你確定嗎？
因為你那句話往往只是一種 比較客氣的說法， 實際意思是
`外星船艦請注意： 表明身分，否則格殺勿論。 '
無論如何，我是斯帕西虛空 船「逐星者號」的菲弗船長
奉命駐守這個行星系， 隸屬強大的地球衛戍星際部 隊
那是我們的主人烏爾關為了 防止地球人耍花樣而在此成 立的。

entries.label: dont_kill
entries.body: Don't kill us!
entries.source: Don't kill us!
entries.translation: 別殺我們！

entries.label: we_fight_1
entries.body: You attacked our lander -- killed our crew! Prepare to die.
entries.source: You attacked our lander -- killed our crew! Prepare to die.
entries.translation: 你攻擊了我們的登陸艇—— 殺死了我們的船員！ 準備受死吧。

entries.label: we_fight_2
entries.body: Enough of your slimy yammering. We fight!
entries.source: Enough of your slimy yammering. We fight!
entries.translation: 少在那裡黏答答地囉嗦了。 開戰！

entries.label: OK_WONT
entries.body:
Uh, okay... sure, we won't!
Just remember though -- this offer may be revoked at any time.
entries.source:
Uh, okay... sure, we won't!
Just remember though -- this offer may be revoked at any time.
entries.translation:
呃，好吧……當然， 我們不會！
不過請記住——這項承諾隨 時可能撤回。

entries.label: do_cultural
entries.body: We suggest you immediately perform whatever cultural practices are customary to your species preceding death.
entries.source: We suggest you immediately perform whatever cultural practices are customary to your species preceding death.
entries.translation: 建議你立刻執行自己物種臨 死前的傳統文化習俗， 不論那是什麼。

entries.label: WEZZY_WEZZAH
entries.body:
Certainly, most gracious destroyer, as is well known, before departing this mortal helix
all Spathi must complete the short, poignant ritual of Wezzy-Wezzah to be assured of a secure afterlife
and by allowing us to fulfill this requirement, you too shall be granted immortality in our beautiful afterworld
which is absolutely guaranteed to be free of similarly immortal monsters who would otherwise eat the both of us.

entries.translation:
當然，最仁慈的毀滅者， 眾所皆知，所有斯帕西離開 這凡世螺旋之前
都必須完成簡短感人的 Wezzy-Wezzah 儀式，才能確保來世平安
而你若允許我們完成這項要 求，也能在美麗的來世獲得 永生
那裡絕對保證不會有同樣永 生、否則會把我們兩個都吃 掉的怪物。

entries.label: die_slugboy
entries.body: Die slugboy!
entries.source: Die slugboy!
entries.translation: 受死吧，蛞蝓小子！

entries.label: begin_ritual
entries.body: You may begin your ritual, and if I might make a small suggestion: be done in less than 2 minutes.
entries.source: You may begin your ritual, and if I might make a small suggestion: be done in less than 2 minutes.
entries.translation: 你可以開始儀式了。 容我小小建議一下：請在 2 分鐘內結束。

entries.label: MUST_DO_RITUAL_AT_HOME
entries.body:
Grief and woe -- certainly a destroyer of innocents as well-travelled as yourself
must know that the formalities of Wezzy-Wezzah are invalid unless
performed on the large moon orbiting our homeworld, Spathiwa
which is only 143 light years distant, and, if I remember correctly,
is especially beautiful this time of year.
Shall we go now there?

entries.translation:
悲哀啊，苦難啊——像您這 般見多識廣、專門摧毀無辜 者的人
想必知道，Wezzy-W ezzah 的正式儀式只有在
環繞我們母星斯帕西瓦運行 的巨大衛星上舉行才有效
那裡離此僅僅 143 光年，而且如果我沒記錯，
每年這個時節特別美麗。
我們現在就去那裡，好嗎？

entries.label: you_wont_die_yet
entries.body: Because I am compassionate, you will not die until you have exhausted your usefulness.
entries.source: Because I am compassionate, you will not die until you have exhausted your usefulness.
entries.translation: 出於我的慈悲， 在你失去利用價值前， 我不會殺你。

entries.label: ETERNAL_GRATITUDE
entries.body:
My eternal gratitude is yours, oh devastator of helpless beings.
It's times like these that I am forced to feel almost, though not quite, sorry
that the Ur-Quan so thoroughly defeated and humiliated your species.
entries.source:

that the Ur-Quan so thoroughly defeated and humiliated your species.
entries.translation:
無助眾生的毀滅者啊， 我永遠感激您。
每逢這種時刻， 我幾乎——但還不到完全— —忍不住替您感到遺憾
因為烏爾關把你們的物種擊 敗得如此徹底， 羞辱得如此難堪。

entries.label: we_fight
entries.body: We fight!
entries.source: We fight!
entries.translation: 開戰！

entries.label: pay_for_crimes
entries.body: Now you must pay for the crimes of your craven masters, the evil Ur-Quan.
entries.source: Now you must pay for the crimes of your craven masters, the evil Ur-Quan.
entries.translation: 現在，你必須為懦弱主人邪 惡烏爾關犯下的罪行付出代 價。

entries.label: CLUTCH_MAVEN
entries.body:
In this difficult situation I am reminded of what my clutch maven once said to me before my first molting.
`Sometimes the enemy is so swift and the path so treacherous that you can run no further.
It is then that you must turn and resolve to fight
and in all likelihood die horribly
but you never know when you are going to get lucky, so go for it!'

身陷這種困境， 讓我想起第一次蛻殼前， 孵巢導師曾對我說的話。
`有時敵人快得驚人， 道路又凶險萬分， 讓你再也逃不下去。
那時你就必須轉身， 下定決心戰鬥
然後十之八九會死得慘不忍 睹
不過運氣何時會來誰也說不 準，所以放手一搏吧！'

entries.label: you_may_live
entries.body: I find myself moved by your deep commitment to your rituals and ancestral ways. You may live.
entries.source: I find myself moved by your deep commitment to your rituals and ancestral ways. You may live.
entries.translation: 你對儀式和祖傳習俗如此執 著，令我深受感動。 你可以活下去。

entries.label: HONEST_AND_FRIENDLY
entries.body:
That settles it, for now I am certain that you are an honest and friendly being
who is forced entirely through unfortunate circumstance - the unreasonable hostility of the Universe
to travel the galaxy in a ship which, according to my sensors
is best suited to conducting planetary-scale genocide.

只是完全受不幸情勢——也 就是宇宙毫不講理的敵意— —所迫
才會駕著一艘據我感測器判 斷
最適合執行行星規模種族滅 絕的船艦遨遊銀河。

entries.label: what_are_coordinates
entries.body: We'd be delighted to accompany you to your homeworld. What are its HyperSpace coordinates?
entries.source: We'd be delighted to accompany you to your homeworld. What are its HyperSpace coordinates?
entries.translation: 我們很樂意陪你回母星。 它的超空間座標是多少？

entries.label: COORDINATES_ARE
entries.body:
My most wonderful planet Spathiwa circles a safe distance from the orange giant star Yuffo
which is at HyperSpace coordinates
hey -- wait a minute!
Is this some kind of Homosap trick to get the location of my homeworld
so that you can visit it with devastation?!

hey -- wait a minute!
Is this some kind of Homosap trick to get the location of my homeworld

entries.translation:
我最美好的行星斯帕西瓦， 與橙色巨星 Yuffo 保持安全距離運行
那顆星的超空間座標是
嘿——等一下！
這該不會是智人種的詭計， 想套出我母星的位置
好讓你們上門大肆破壞 吧？！

entries.label: tell_me_coordinates
entries.body: Just tell me the coordinates, alien dog-slime!
entries.source: Just tell me the coordinates, alien dog-slime!
entries.translation: 快把座標告訴我， 你這外星狗鼻涕！

Hmmm... I see
Very well then, your threats have convinced me to reveal this secret.
Spathiwa is the 1st planet out from the star at HyperSpace (570.4, 979.5)

entries.translation:
嗯……我明白了
好吧，你的威脅說服我揭露 這項祕密。
斯帕西瓦是超空間座標 (570.4, 979.5) 那顆恆星向外數的第 1 顆行星

entries.label: TOO_SCARY
entries.body:
You've got so many ships in your fleet, that instead of joining you
I think I'll just run away.
entries.source:
You've got so many ships in your fleet, that instead of joining you
I think I'll just run away.
entries.translation:
你的艦隊裡有這麼多船， 所以與其加入你
我想我還是逃走算了。

entries.label: youve_got_me_all_wrong
entries.body: No, no, no! You've got me all wrong. I promise I'll be nice.
entries.source: No, no, no! You've got me all wrong. I promise I'll be nice.
entries.translation: 不不不！你完全誤會我了。 我保證會好好待你。

entries.label: SORRY_NO_COORDS
entries.body:
Er... I just don't know.
I want to believe you, I really do, but the risk to my people is just too great.
Anyway I think I just forgot the coordinates -- let me see if I can remember them
nope!
I'm afraid they're gone forever, so torturing me would just be a waste of your time.

呃……我真的不知道。
我想相信你，我真的想， 但這對我族人的風險實在太 大了。
反正我好像剛剛忘了座標— —讓我看看能不能想起來
想不起來！
恐怕它們永遠消失了， 所以折磨我只會浪費你的時 間。

entries.label: what_doing_on_pluto_1
entries.body: What are you doing here on Pluto?
entries.source: What are you doing here on Pluto?
entries.translation: 你在冥王星上做什麼？

entries.label: ABOUT_20_YEARS_AGO
entries.body:
About 20 years ago, this region of space was dominated by a loose confederation known as the Alliance of Free Stars,
which was composed of the aliens native to these parts who didn't want to be enslaved.
They made a valiant effort against the superior Ur-Quan forces
and it even looked like they might miraculously defeat the combined Ur-Quan armada
right up to the point at which the Ur-Quan totally defeated - indeed, annihilated them.

大約 20 年前，這片太空區域由一個 名為自由星辰聯盟的鬆散邦 聯支配，
成員是生於此地、 不願遭到奴役的外星人。
他們英勇抵抗兵力占優的烏 爾關
看起來甚至可能奇蹟般擊敗 烏爾關聯合艦隊
直到烏爾關徹底擊敗——事 實上是消滅了他們。

entries.label: what_doing_on_pluto_2
entries.body: So, what ARE you doing here on Pluto?
entries.source: So, what ARE you doing here on Pluto?
entries.translation: 所以，你到底在冥王星上做 什麼？

entries.label: WHEN_URQUAN_ARRIVED
entries.body:
When the Ur-Quan armada entered this system to subjugate formally the Earthlings,
the Ur-Quan presented the humans with the standard slave options:
join the Hierarchy as combat thralls, and retain some autonomy, including the right to travel through space
or become a 'fallow' species and return to pre-atomic savagery on the surface of their homeworld
encased for all time beneath an impenetrable force shield.
The Humans chose the latter option, and so were swiftly imprisoned on the surface of Earth
but the Ur-Quan didn't trust them to obey the restrictions...so
they chose a small group of Hierarchy combat starships from the Ilwrath and Spathi fleets
to create the so-called Earthguard, and stationed them at a base on Earth's moon.

烏爾關艦隊進入這個星系， 正式征服地球人時，
向人類提出了標準的奴役選 項：
以戰奴身分加入戰奴階序， 保留部分自主權， 包括穿越太空的權利
或者成為「休耕」物種， 回到母星表面的前原子野蠻 生活
永遠被封在一道無法穿透的 力場護盾下。
人類選擇了後者， 因此很快便被囚禁在地球表 面
但烏爾關不相信他們會遵守 限制……所以
烏爾關從伊爾拉斯與斯帕西 艦隊中挑出一小批戰奴階序 戰鬥星艦
組成所謂的地球衛戍隊， 並派駐地球月球上的基地。

entries.label: where_are_urquan
entries.body: Where are the Ur-Quan now?
entries.source: Where are the Ur-Quan now?
entries.translation: 烏爾關現在在哪裡？

entries.label: URQUAN_LEFT
entries.body:
Our masters don't really keep us very well informed about their goings on
so all that we know is that immediately after the subjugation of the last Alliance race
the Yehat, I think
the Ur-Quan gathered their dreadnoughts and departed towards the edge of the galaxy
commanding us to obey the slave laws or face their wrath when they returned.

我們的主人不太願意向我們 交代他們的行蹤
所以我們只知道， 最後一個聯盟種族遭到征服 後
我想是耶哈特吧
烏爾關就集結無畏艦， 朝銀河系邊緣離去
命令我們遵守奴役法規， 否則等他們回來就要承受其 怒火。

entries.label: what_about_other_races
entries.body: Do you know anything about other alien races?
entries.source: Do you know anything about other alien races?

entries.label: ABOUT_OTHER_RACES
entries.body:
We know only bits and pieces of what happened to each race; for instance,
when defeated, the Yehat joined the Hierarchy as combat thralls,
while the Syreen chose to be slave shielded on a planet in the BugSquirt star system.
No, that's not right -- I forget it's name, anyway where was I?
Oh yes, the Shofixti! They were utterly wiped out in a gigantic 'blaze of glory'.

entries.label: what_doing_on_pluto_3
entries.body: TELL ME what you are doing on Pluto, NOW!
entries.source: TELL ME what you are doing on Pluto, NOW!
entries.translation: 現在就告訴我， 你到底在冥王星上做什麼！

entries.label: what_about_yourself
entries.body: What about yourself, Fwiffo?
entries.source: What about yourself, Fwiffo?
entries.translation: 那你自己呢，菲弗？

entries.label: ABOUT_MYSELF
entries.body:
Me? You mean me, personally? How nice of you to ask!
I was born a poor, green encrustling, the youngest child of a family of 18,487.
My male parent had to work hard to support us, very hard
but each of my brothers and sisters and I tried to help out to make ends meet.
The female parent was kind and sweet to all of us.
Why, she once even called me by NAME; she said
`Fwiffo! Fwiffo darling! Would you please answer the door? I think someone's there.'
What a treat! A golden memory.
I swiftly matured into a fine example of my species, with my parents' assistance, achieved independence.
Specifically, they pried me from the doorjamb, and rolled me into the street.
Thus prepared, I set out to make my fortune.
I had great dreams in those days, yes, great dreams!
I knew that someday I would be vastly rich, wealthy enough to afford a large, well-fortified mansion.
Surrounding my mansion would be vast tracts of land, through which I could slide at any time I wished!
Of course, one can never be too sure that there aren't monsters hiding just behind the next bush
so I would plant trees to climb at regular, easy to reach intervals.
And being a Spathi of the World, I would know that some monsters climb trees, though often not well
so I would have my servants place in each tree a basket of perfect stones
not too heavy, not too light -- just the right size for throwing at monsters.
I was thinking about what color the stones would be painted (aqua, mauve or magenta)
when a vegetable cart came careening down the street outside my house, and knocked me unconscious.
When I awoke, I was aboard the voidship StarRunner, headed for Earth.
Apparently I had been out of my head for quite some time after the accident
and with the assistance of some kind strangers
had been relieved of my funds and convinced to join the navy
where I have been unpleasantly employed for the last 25 years.

entries.translation:
我？你是指我本人嗎？ 你真貼心，居然會問！
我出生時只是個貧窮的綠色 結殼幼體，是 18,487 個孩子中最小的一個。
我的雄性親代得努力工作才 能養活我們，非常努力
但每個兄弟姊妹和我都設法 幫忙，好讓家裡勉強過活。
雌性親代對我們每一個都親 切又溫柔。
她甚至有一次叫了我的名 字；她說
`菲弗！親愛的菲弗！ 可以去應門嗎？ 我想外面有人。'
多麼難得！一段金色的回 憶。
在親代協助下， 我很快成長為物種中的傑出 典範，並成功獨立。
具體來說，他們把我從門框 上撬下來，滾到街上。
做好如此準備後， 我就出發追求財富。
那些日子裡，我懷抱偉大夢 想，沒錯，偉大的夢想！
我知道自己總有一天會富可 敵國，有錢買下一座大型防 禦宅邸。
宅邸四周會有無邊無際的土 地，想什麼時候滑行都可 以！
當然，誰也不能確定下一叢 灌木後面沒有怪物躲著
所以我會每隔一段很容易抵 達的距離，就種一棵可供攀 爬的樹。
身為見過世面的斯帕西， 我會知道有些怪物也能爬 樹，儘管通常爬得不好
所以我要僕人在每棵樹上放 一籃完美的石頭
不太重，也不太輕——大小 正好適合拿來丟怪物。
我正想著石頭該漆成什麼顏 色（水藍、淡紫還是洋紅）
一輛蔬菜車就從我家外的街 道失控衝來，把我撞昏了。
醒來時，我已在虛空船「逐 星者號」上，正前往地球。
顯然意外後我神智不清了好 一段時間
還有一些好心陌生人從旁協 助
替我卸下錢財重擔， 又說服我加入海軍
從此我就在那裡很不愉快地 服役了 25 年。

entries.label: STATIONED_ON_EARTH_MOON
entries.body:
Originally, we were stationed on Earth's moon, which made us Spathi a bit uneasy
because with each passing day we grew more and more worried about the sneaky Earthlings making a surprise attack
though the Ilwrath kept telling us that was impossible
since the Earthlings had no ships or weapons whatsoever.
That made us feel a bit better, but when the Ilwrath left, again we grew fearful
and decided to make a strategic redeployment to Mars.
Later on we decided it would be prudent to relocate to Jupiter's moon, Ganymede
then later Saturn's moon, Titan
and finally here to Pluto.

entries.translation:
我們原本駐守地球的月球， 這讓斯帕西有點不安
因為日子一天天過去， 我們越來越擔心狡猾的地球 人會發動突襲
儘管伊爾拉斯不斷告訴我 們，那是不可能的
畢竟地球人根本沒有任何船 艦或武器。
這讓我們安心了一點， 但伊爾拉斯離開後， 我們又害怕起來
於是決定戰略性重新部署到 火星。
後來我們認為，謹慎起見， 應該轉移到木星的衛星甘尼 米德
接著又移往土星的衛星泰坦
最後來到冥王星這裡。

entries.label: what_blaze_of_glory
entries.body: What do you mean, `blaze of glory'? What happened to the Shofixti?
entries.source: What do you mean, `blaze of glory'? What happened to the Shofixti?
entries.translation: 你說的「榮耀烈焰」是什麼 意思？索菲克斯提發生了什 麼事？

entries.label: BLAZE_IS
entries.body:
The Shofixti were half feral, as you know, having been uplifted by the Yehat
just a few decades before the start of the war.
Given their habit of detonating those suicidal, so-called 'Glory Devices' in combat
it came as no particular surprise to me when, upon the arrival of the Ur-Quan primary task force at their homeworld
the Shofixti caused their sun to explode in a colossal supernova
destroying the entire planetary system, and not incidentally dozens of Ur-Quan Dreadnoughts!
(Snork-snork-snork!)

entries.translation:
如你所知，索菲克斯提本來 半是野獸，直到戰爭爆發前 幾十年
才受到耶哈特提升。
想到他們在戰鬥中動不動就 引爆那種自殺用的所謂「榮 耀裝置」
所以烏爾關主力特遣隊抵達 母星時
索菲克斯提引爆自己的太 陽，造成巨大超新星
摧毀整個行星系， 順便炸掉幾十艘烏爾關無畏 艦，我一點也不意外！
（嗅咯－嗅咯－嗅咯！）

entries.label: what_about_moonbase
entries.body: What is happening at the base on Luna then?
entries.source: What is happening at the base on Luna then?
entries.translation: 那麼，月球基地現在是什麼 情況？

entries.label: SET_UP_BASE
entries.body:
We decided that if the Earthlings figured out we had abandoned the base on Luna
they would be more likely to try something sneaky.
So we rigged up some old service androids and ordered them to drive around on the lunar surface in bulldozers,
endlessly pushing around the same piles of dirt.
In addition, we connected the base's local radio transmitter to an audio Melnorme FunRom
called `Winky's Happy Night', hoping that they would think we were still there.

entries.translation:
我們認為，如果地球人發現 我們放棄了月球基地
他們就更可能耍花樣。
所以我們改裝了一些老舊維 修機器人，命令它們駕著推 土機在月球表面到處跑，
沒完沒了地推動同樣幾堆泥 土。
此外，我們把基地的本地無 線電發射器接上一套梅爾諾 姆 FunRom 音訊產品
名叫 `Winky 的快樂之夜'， 希望他們以為我們還在那 裡。

entries.label: what_about_ilwrath
entries.body: What happened to the Ilwrath stationed in this system?
entries.source: What happened to the Ilwrath stationed in this system?
entries.translation: 駐守這個星系的伊爾拉斯怎 麼了？

entries.label: ABOUT_ILWRATH
entries.body:
The Ilwrath contingent were supposed to be the toughest ridge-crest, er
the most rigid flipper, no
ah yes - the BACKBONE of the Earthguard force; but they departed the system en masse
not long after the last Ur-Quan Dreadnought vanished from this region of space.
They claimed to have received a direct order from their Gods of Evil and Darkness,
who had grown dissatisfied with the Ilwraths' passivity
and wanted them to kill or at least torture someone soon.
Personally, I believe they just got bored and went off to have some fun.

entries.translation:
伊爾拉斯分遣隊理應是地球 衛戍部隊最堅硬的脊冠，呃
最僵直的鰭肢，不對
啊對了——是中流砥柱； 但最後一艘烏爾關無畏艦離 開這片太空區域後不久
他們就全體離開了這個星 系。
他們聲稱收到邪惡與黑暗諸 神的直接命令，
那些神不滿伊爾拉斯消極怠 惰
要他們趕快去殺人， 至少也得折磨幾個。
我個人認為，他們只是無聊 了，跑去找樂子。

entries.label: what_about_other_spathi
entries.body: What happened to the other Spathi ships?
entries.source: What happened to the other Spathi ships?
entries.translation: 其他斯帕西船艦怎麼了？

entries.label: really_thousands
entries.body: Hundreds? Come on.
entries.source: Hundreds? Come on.
entries.translation: 幾百艘？少來了。

entries.label: SPATHI_ARE
entries.body:
Over the past years, it became necessary to redeploy strategically some of our Earthguard forces
to our homeworld in case of a sudden surprise attack by a vicious, unrelenting alien race which we Spathi call
The Ultimate Evil!
entries.source:
Over the past years, it became necessary to redeploy strategically some of our Earthguard forces
to our homeworld in case of a sudden surprise attack by a vicious, unrelenting alien race which we Spathi call
The Ultimate Evil!
entries.translation:
過去幾年間，我們不得不把 部分地球衛戍部隊戰略性重 新部署
到母星，以防一個凶殘無 情、被我們斯帕西稱為
終極邪惡的外星種族突然襲 擊！

entries.label: what_enemy
entries.body: Who or what is this `Ultimate Evil'?
entries.source: Who or what is this `Ultimate Evil'?
entries.translation: 這個「終極邪惡」是誰， 或是什麼東西？

entries.label: ENEMY_IS
entries.body:
As yet, the Ultimate Evil remains largely unmanifest, and its powers and exact intentions are still a bit obscure
since it lurks just outside the range of even the most sensitive, long-range detectors
which we feel gives conclusive evidence as to The Ultimate Evil's nefarious intent.

entries.translation:
終極邪惡至今仍大致沒有顯 現，其力量與確切意圖也還 有點模糊
因為它潛伏在最靈敏長程偵 測器的範圍之外
而我們認為，這已是終極邪 惡居心不良的確鑿證據。

entries.label: when_ilwrath
entries.body: When do you expect the Ilwrath to return?
entries.source: When do you expect the Ilwrath to return?
entries.translation: 你預計伊爾拉斯何時會回 來？

entries.label: THEN_ILWRATH
entries.body:
Well, when they were pushing up into HyperSpace 18 years ago, we asked them that very question
and I think they said something to the effect of
`Real Soon'.
entries.source:
Well, when they were pushing up into HyperSpace 18 years ago, we asked them that very question
and I think they said something to the effect of
`Real Soon'.
entries.translation:
嗯，18 年前他們正上升進入超空間 時，我們問過完全相同的問 題
我想他們大概是這麼說的
`很快就回來'。

entries.label: why_you_here
entries.body: Why are you still here, Captain Fwiffo?
entries.source: Why are you still here, Captain Fwiffo?
entries.translation: 你為什麼還留在這裡， 菲弗船長？

entries.label: DREW_SHORT_STRAW
entries.body:
Since it was our most powerful and unforgiving masters, the Ur-Quan, who stationed us here
we knew it would be grossly stupid to disobey them completely
but we decided that it would be okay to send just one ship home.
We used one of our most ancient and solemn rituals, Puun-Taffy, to pick the lucky ship.
Then... some months later, we decided that it wouldn't REALLY hurt if we sent one more ship home
and then later we sent another, and then another...well, you get the idea.
Alas, as fate would have it, when the final ritual was performed
I, Fwiffo, was left here alone, for as even the most immature encrustling knows
there must always be one Spathi who picks the short Ta Puun stick.

entries.translation:
既然把我們派來這裡的是最 強大又最不寬容的主人烏爾 關
我們知道徹底違抗他們愚蠢 至極
但覺得只送一艘船回家應該 沒關係。
我們用最古老莊嚴的 Puun-Taffy 儀式，選出那艘幸運船艦。
然後……幾個月後， 我們認為再送一艘船回家其 實也不會怎樣
後來又送走一艘，再一 艘……嗯，你懂我的意思。
唉，命運弄人， 最後一次儀式完成時
我菲弗就這樣獨自留在這 裡，因為就連最幼小的結殼 幼體都知道
永遠得有一名斯帕西抽中最 短的 Ta Puun 籤。

entries.label: how_many_crew
entries.body: How many crew do you have aboard?
entries.source: How many crew do you have aboard?
entries.translation: 你的船上有多少船員？

entries.label: JUST_ME
entries.body:
I am undone! You are far too clever for a poor Spathi like me
and now I must submit to your superior, alien intellect.
I guess I am not revealing any truly important secrets if I tell you
that each of my species' Eluder-class Voidships typically holds 30 Spathi crewmen
though at present my vessel, the StarRunner, is not up to full complement
due to the needs of my homeworld in their resistance against the Ultimate Evil
and in fact my vessel is somewhat understaffed right now
seeing as how I am the only Spathi on board, which is a bit frightening as I am sure you can understand.

我完了！你對我這種可憐的 斯帕西來說實在太聰明
現在我只能屈服於你優越的 外星智慧。
我想，如果告訴你以下事 情，應該不算洩漏真正重要 的祕密
我們物種每艘逃逸艦級虛空 船通常可容納 30 名斯帕西船員
不過目前我的船「逐星者 號」編制並不完整
因為母星抵抗終極邪惡需要 人手
事實上，我的船現在有點人 力不足
畢竟船上只有我一名斯帕 西，我相信你能理解， 這有點嚇人。

entries.label: THOUSANDS
entries.body:
Dozens -- that is to say, scores and perhaps even hundreds of my brethren stride through the corridors
of this specially modified, super-efficient, mass-destruction-oriented starship
which could lay siege to an entire planetary system should we choose to do so
which, fortunately for you, we have decided not to do, today.

entries.translation:
幾十名——也就是說， 好幾十名，或許甚至有數百 名同胞昂首穿梭於走廊
這艘特別改造、效率超高、 專為大規模毀滅設計的星艦
只要我們願意， 便能圍攻整個行星系
而你很走運，我們今天決定 不這麼做。

entries.label: full_of_monsters
entries.body: The galaxy teems with threatening monsters. Are you happy here -- alone and vulnerable?
entries.source: The galaxy teems with threatening monsters. Are you happy here -- alone and vulnerable?
entries.translation: 銀河裡到處是危險怪物。 你獨自一個又毫無防備， 待在這裡開心嗎？

entries.label: HOW_TRUE
entries.body:
How true, Captain, how true!
In truth, just between us, during the past seven years, I have been quite ill at ease
and yet now I find myself enjoying your company, this witty dialog
and the presence of your huge, powerful, death-dealing starship which being my friend
you would certainly feel compelled to use in order to save me from any hostile lifeforms
who threatened me with death.

說得太對了，艦長， 太對了！
老實說，只有我們兩個知 道，過去七年我一直很不自 在
然而現在，我發現自己很享 受您的陪伴、這場機智對談
還有您那艘巨大、強力、 專門奪命的星艦； 既然它是我的朋友
若有任何敵對生命以死亡威 脅我
您當然會覺得非用它救我不 可。

entries.label: join_us
entries.body: I'm sure you'd feel a lot safer if you were with us. Come on, Fwiffo, join our fleet!
entries.source: I'm sure you'd feel a lot safer if you were with us. Come on, Fwiffo, join our fleet!
entries.translation: 跟我們在一起肯定安全多 了。來吧，菲弗， 加入我們的艦隊！

entries.label: WILL_JOIN
entries.body:
Happy days and jubilation!
I discard all prejudice and hesitations and accept and celebrate your offer of protection
and your undying commitment to my well-being!
I must wax melancholy for just a moment though
and make sure you understand that any other Spathi ships we meet at large in the galaxy
are not going to be quite so responsive to your friendly gestures as myself
since they bear more heavily the yoke of Ur-Quan enslavement
and are also apt to talk themselves out of allying with a totally unknown alien
which I, having been left here alone, cannot do.
Welcome me aboard, captain!

and are also apt to talk themselves out of allying with a totally unknown alien
which I, having been left here alone, cannot do.
Welcome me aboard, captain!
entries.translation:
歡欣鼓舞，普天同慶！
我拋棄所有偏見與猶豫， 欣然接受並慶祝您的保護提 議
以及您對我安危永不動搖的 承諾！
不過我得暫時多愁善感一下
請您務必明白， 我們在銀河各處遇到的其他 斯帕西船艦
不會像我一樣如此熱情回應 您的友好姿態
因為烏爾關的奴役枷鎖在他 們身上更加沉重
而且他們很可能會說服自 己，絕不能與來路不明的外 星人結盟
但我被獨自留在這裡， 沒辦法這麼做。
歡迎我上船吧，艦長！

entries.label: WONT_JOIN_1
entries.body:
Well... I really want to
but I am just not sure that under the present circumstances
joining you in your exciting and also dangerous space-adventures would be the best course of action right now
because the Ur-Quan could return at any minute and the punishment they would bestow on me for such treason
would make any other horrible death seem like big fun by comparison.
Thanks for the offer, though.

entries.translation:
嗯……我真的很想
但我不太確定在目前情況下
加入你刺激又危險的太空冒 險是不是此刻最好的選擇
因為烏爾關隨時可能回來， 而他們對這種叛變降下的懲 罰
相比之下，會讓任何其他慘 死方式都像無比歡樂。
不過還是謝謝你的邀請。

entries.label: give_ship_or_die
entries.body: Give us your ship or you will be destroyed!
entries.source: Give us your ship or you will be destroyed!
entries.translation: 把船交給我們， 否則就摧毀你！

entries.label: WONT_JOIN_2
entries.body:
You build a strong case, Captain.
Here I am, alone and undefended on the surface of a hostile alien world.
Above me you hover in orbit, encrusted with beam guns, missile launchers and other, more dreadful weapons.
So I think to myself: Fwiffo, is it prudent to remain here, as vulnerable as a moltling on a skillet?
`NO', I answer myself, `JOIN THE HUMAN - HE IS KIND AND GOOD!'
But then a wicked voice whispers:
`beware... the human is tricking you! If you join him, you will die alone, in the cold of space.'
And for reasons beyond my understanding, Captain, this voice overwhelms the other
and so I must remain here...largely against my will.

entries.translation:
艦長，您的論點很有說服 力。
此刻我孤身一人， 毫無防衛，身處敵對外星世 界的表面。
您則在上方軌道盤旋， 船上滿是光束砲、 飛彈發射器和其他更可怕的 武器。
所以我對自己說：菲弗， 像平底鍋上的蛻殼幼體一樣 留在這裡任人宰割， 明智嗎？
`不！'我回答自己， `加入那個人類——他親切 又善良！'
但接著，一個邪惡聲音低 語：
`小心……人類在騙你！ 加入他，你就會孤單死在冰 冷太空裡。'
而艦長，出於我無法理解的 理由，這道聲音壓過了另一 道
所以我必須留在這裡…… 大體上並非出於自願。

entries.label: WONT_JOIN_3
entries.body:
Twice before you have asked this question, Captain. Will the third time be the charm?
Alas, I fear not.
entries.source:
Twice before you have asked this question, Captain. Will the third time be the charm?
Alas, I fear not.
entries.translation:
艦長，您已經問過兩次了。 第三次會帶來好運嗎？
唉，恐怕不會。

entries.label: GEE_THANKS
entries.body: Gee, thanks.
entries.source: Gee, thanks.
entries.translation: 哇，謝啦。

entries.label: changed_mind
entries.body: I've changed my mind. We'll attack you.
entries.source: I've changed my mind. We'll attack you.
entries.translation: 我改變主意了。 我們要攻擊你。

entries.label: youre_forgiven
entries.body: We understand that sometimes these tragic misunderstandings happen. We grieve, but are not bitter.
entries.source: We understand that sometimes these tragic misunderstandings happen. We grieve, but are not bitter.
entries.translation: 我們理解這種悲慘的誤會有 時難免發生。我們雖然哀 痛，但並不怨恨。

entries.label: THANKS_FOR_FORGIVENESS
entries.body: Whew, thanks! For a minute there, I thought you were going to kill me!
entries.source: Whew, thanks! For a minute there, I thought you were going to kill me!
entries.translation: 呼，謝啦！剛才有那麼一會 兒，我還以為你要殺了我！

entries.label: HATE_YOU_FOREVER_SPACE
entries.body:
I fear to face you in combat, but I know if I do not, you will just grow stronger with each passing week.
Therfore I must face you now.
I set the thrusters to maximum, close my eye, and begin pressing the fire stud wildly.
entries.source:
I fear to face you in combat, but I know if I do not, you will just grow stronger with each passing week.
Therfore I must face you now.
I set the thrusters to maximum, close my eye, and begin pressing the fire stud wildly.
entries.translation:
我害怕在戰鬥中面對你， 但我知道若不動手， 你只會一週比一週更強。
所以我現在非得面對你不 可。
我把推進器開到最大， 閉上眼睛，開始瘋狂亂按開 火鈕。

entries.label: INIT_ANGRY_HELLO_SPACE
entries.body:
You are mean, cruel and deceitful. I suspect you are an Ilwrath in ape's clothing.
What do you want?
entries.source:
You are mean, cruel and deceitful. I suspect you are an Ilwrath in ape's clothing.
What do you want?
entries.translation:
你卑鄙、殘酷又奸詐。 我懷疑你是披著猿皮的伊爾 拉斯。
你想怎樣？

entries.label: SUBSEQUENT_ANGRY_HELLO_SPACE
entries.body:
Ah, Mister Nasty is back. I wonder what he wants today? Peace, Happiness, Joy for all?
No, I fear, death and unmitigated destruction is his traditional fare.
Am I correct?
entries.source:
Ah, Mister Nasty is back. I wonder what he wants today? Peace, Happiness, Joy for all?
No, I fear, death and unmitigated destruction is his traditional fare.
Am I correct?
entries.translation:
啊，壞蛋先生又來了。 不知道他今天想要什麼？ 和平、幸福、眾生歡樂？
不，恐怕他照例點的是死亡 和徹底毀滅。
我說得對嗎？

entries.label: INIT_NEUTRAL_HELLO_SPACE
entries.body:
Surprise and Terror!
I am greeted by the smooth and hostile face of our old enemy, the Hootmans
no... the Huge-glands, no, I remember, the Hunams!
entries.source:
Surprise and Terror!
I am greeted by the smooth and hostile face of our old enemy, the Hootmans
no... the Huge-glands, no, I remember, the Hunams!
entries.translation:
驚奇與恐怖！
迎面而來的是老敵人呼特曼 平滑而充滿敵意的臉
不對……是巨腺人，不對， 我想起來了，是休南人！

entries.label: SUBSEQUENT_NEUTRAL_HELLO_SPACE
entries.body: Hello, Hunam, what would you like to threaten me about today?
entries.source: Hello, Hunam, what would you like to threaten me about today?
entries.translation: 你好，休南人， 今天想拿什麼威脅我？

entries.label: INIT_FRIENDLY_HELLO_SPACE
entries.body: Hello friend Hunam! How nice to see you again. Kill anyone today?
entries.source: Hello friend Hunam! How nice to see you again. Kill anyone today?
entries.translation: 你好，休南朋友！ 真高興又見到你。 今天殺了誰嗎？

entries.label: SUBSEQUENT_FRIENDLY_HELLO_SPACE
entries.body:
...No! No! Weapons Officer, don't fire! It's the Hunam again, you idiot!
What! The viewscreen? What are you...oh.
Hello Friend Hunam! How are you? We are just fine, real swell.
No problems at all! Just fine. No problems at all!
entries.source:
...No! No! Weapons Officer, don't fire! It's the Hunam again, you idiot!
What! The viewscreen? What are you...oh.
Hello Friend Hunam! How are you? We are just fine, real swell.
No problems at all! Just fine. No problems at all!
entries.translation:
……不！不！武器官， 別開火！又是那個休南人， 你這白痴！
什麼！觀景螢幕？你在…… 喔。
你好，休南朋友！ 最近好嗎？我們很好， 好得不得了。
完全沒問題！一切都好。 完全沒問題！

entries.label: INIT_ALLIED_HELLO_SPACE
entries.body:
Hello Captain Ally Hunam! We are here in this place at this time
just like you -- how wonderful.
entries.source:
Hello Captain Ally Hunam! We are here in this place at this time
just like you -- how wonderful.
entries.translation:
你好，休南盟友艦長！ 我們此時此刻也在這個地方
就跟你一樣——多麼美妙。

entries.label: SUBSEQUENT_ALLIED_HELLO_SPACE
entries.body:
Ah, Hunam! I was just wondering... is Tuffa-Yuf still alive?
Have you seen him, is he well?
He was sent to your Earth Starbase a while ago
to captain an Eluder vessel as part of our mutual assistance pact.
Rest assured, he will be an excellent addition to your elite force.
Those weeks of intense training always result in an officer of the highest caliber.
If you see him, please let him know
that I still consider his debt valid, and expect prompt payment.
Thank you.

entries.translation:
啊，休南人！我正好想 問……Tuffa-Yuf 還活著嗎？
你見過他嗎？他過得好嗎？
前一陣子，他被派到你們的 地球星際基地
依照雙方互助協定， 擔任一艘逃逸艦的艦長。
請放心，他會是你們精銳部 隊的優秀新血。
那幾週密集訓練， 總能造就最高水準的軍官。
如果見到他，請代我轉告
我仍認為他的債務有效， 而且要求立刻還款。
謝謝。

entries.label: give_info_space
entries.body: Spathi - though we are not on the best of terms, would you please give me some information?
entries.source: Spathi - though we are not on the best of terms, would you please give me some information?
entries.translation: 斯帕西——雖然我們交情不 算太好，能否請你提供一些 情報？

entries.label: HERES_SOME_INFO
entries.body:
Gladly, and here it is - now listen carefully for I will only say it once.
Do not ask favors of people you routinely ambush and murder.
entries.source:
Gladly, and here it is - now listen carefully for I will only say it once.
Do not ask favors of people you routinely ambush and murder.
entries.translation:
樂意之至，情報如下——現 在仔細聽，我只說一次。
別向你經常伏擊並殺害的人 討人情。

entries.label: we_sorry_space
entries.body: Hey, look. We've made mistakes, I admit it! But we'll just be friends, hmmm?
entries.source: Hey, look. We've made mistakes, I admit it! But we'll just be friends, hmmm?
entries.translation: 嘿，聽我說。我承認， 我們犯過錯！但現在就當朋 友，好嗎？

entries.label: APOLOGIZE_AT_HOMEWORLD
entries.body:
My soul is warmed by your sincere and heartfelt words.
It is decided -- we shall be friends forever.
However, I soon must go about my duties, and sadly we may never see each other again.
I will remember you forever, Captain.
And as your new friend, I can confide that should you decide to make a more general plea to the Spathi
say for your past deeds of thuggery
you would be well advised to seek the High Ruling Council at Spathiwa.
Goodbye...friend.

entries.translation:
你真誠又發自肺腑的話語溫 暖了我的靈魂。
就這麼決定了——我們永遠 是朋友。
不過我很快就得去執行任 務，遺憾的是， 我們可能再也見不到彼此。
艦長，我會永遠記得你。
身為你的新朋友， 我可以私下透露， 若你決定向全體斯帕西提出 更普遍的請求
例如請求原諒你過去的暴行
最好前往斯帕西瓦， 尋求最高統治議會。
再見……朋友。

entries.label: we_fight_again_space
entries.body: This battle stuff is fun! Let's do some more of it!
entries.source: This battle stuff is fun! Let's do some more of it!
entries.translation: 戰鬥真好玩！我們再多打幾 場吧！

entries.label: OK_FIGHT_AGAIN_SPACE
entries.body: Aghk! You are twisted and perverse! You deserve to die.
entries.source: Aghk! You are twisted and perverse! You deserve to die.
entries.translation: 啊呃！你扭曲又變態！ 你該死。

entries.label: bye_angry_space
entries.body: Don't go away mad, Spathi. Just go away.
entries.source: Don't go away mad, Spathi. Just go away.
entries.translation: 斯帕西，別氣沖沖地走。 走就對了。

entries.label: GOODBYE_ANGRY_SPACE
entries.body:
I would like to suggest a new plan for you, Hunam:
depart this region of space, and never return.
entries.source:
I would like to suggest a new plan for you, Hunam:
depart this region of space, and never return.
entries.translation:
休南人，我想向你提一項新 計畫：
離開這片太空區域， 永遠不要回來。

entries.label: look_weird
entries.body: Man! You look weird -- all those claws and your gooey eyeball. Yuck!
entries.source: Man! You look weird -- all those claws and your gooey eyeball. Yuck!
entries.translation: 老天！你長得真怪——那麼 多爪子，還有黏糊糊的眼 球。噁！

entries.label: YOU_LOOK_WEIRD
entries.body: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
entries.source: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
entries.translation: 美，存在於觀看者的眼中。

entries.label: no_look_really_weird
entries.body: No, it's not. You are plain, dog ugly.
entries.source: No, it's not. You are plain, dog ugly.
entries.translation: 才不是。你就是不折不扣， 醜得連狗都嫌。

entries.label: NO_YOU_LOOK_REALLY_WEIRD
entries.body:
Oh yeah? Oh YEAH!?
Well...
You are too.
entries.source:
Oh yeah? Oh YEAH!?
Well...
You are too.
entries.translation:
是喔？是喔！？
那個……
你也一樣。

entries.label: come_in_peace
entries.body: We are on a peaceful mission through the Cosmos.
entries.source: We are on a peaceful mission through the Cosmos.
entries.translation: 我們正執行一項穿越宇宙的 和平任務。

entries.label: AGAINST_NATURE
entries.body:
Two aspects of your last statement defy the course of nature as I know it.
First
`Peace' as you call it, is an illusion.
If you have `Peace', you simply haven't yet seen the thing that's trying to kill you.
Second
Peaceful missions through the Cosmos rarely require weapons large enough to punch holes through a small moon.
entries.source:
Two aspects of your last statement defy the course of nature as I know it.

entries.translation:
你剛才那句話有兩方面違反 了我所知的自然規律。
第一
你所謂的「和平」只是一種 幻覺。
如果你擁有「和平」， 那只是因為還沒看見正試圖 殺你的東西。
第二
穿越宇宙的和平任務， 很少需要足以在小型衛星上 轟出大洞的武器。

entries.label: prepare_to_die
entries.body: Are you prepared to die today, Spathi?
entries.source: Are you prepared to die today, Spathi?
entries.translation: 斯帕西，你今天準備好受死 了嗎？

entries.label: ALWAYS_PREPARED
entries.body:
We Spathi are always prepared to die, we know just what to do.
It goes something like this
AIEEEE! No! Please be merciful! Not my claw! Please, no! I beg of you! The Pain! NO!
entries.source:
We Spathi are always prepared to die, we know just what to do.
It goes something like this
AIEEEE! No! Please be merciful! Not my claw! Please, no! I beg of you! The Pain! NO!
entries.translation:
我們斯帕西永遠準備好赴 死，很清楚該怎麼做。
大概是這樣
咿呀啊啊！不要！ 求你大發慈悲！ 別碰我的爪子！求求你， 不要！好痛！不要啊！

entries.label: since_friendly_give_stuff
entries.body: Since we are now friends, it is customary for you to give us things.
entries.source: Since we are now friends, it is customary for you to give us things.
entries.translation: 既然我們現在是朋友， 照慣例你應該送我們一些東 西。

entries.label: GIVE_ADVICE
entries.body:
Certainly, perhaps beginning with some advice.
Don't presume we are stupid.
entries.source:
Certainly, perhaps beginning with some advice.
Don't presume we are stupid.
entries.translation:
當然，或許可以先送你一項 建議。
別以為我們很蠢。

entries.label: whats_up_space_1
entries.body: Friend Spathi, what important facts can you relate?
entries.source: Friend Spathi, what important facts can you relate?
entries.translation: 斯帕西朋友，你能告訴我們 哪些重要事實？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_SPACE_1
entries.body:
I guess the only event of importance I know about concerns the low and stupid Umgah
whose pranks we must suffer on a regular basis.
At least we have removed one source of their annoying jokes -- an unusually strong HyperWave 'Caster
which they used on several occasions to impersonate such frightening characters as
the Grand Master Planet Eaters
Jud the Ineffable Vug
and Killmaster 18.
Needless to say, we did not fall for any of their high jinks.
In fact, we succeeded in taking from the Umgah their precious 'Caster,
thus ending their attempts at sick levity.
entries.source:
I guess the only event of importance I know about concerns the low and stupid Umgah
whose pranks we must suffer on a regular basis.
At least we have removed one source of their annoying jokes -- an unusually strong HyperWave 'Caster
which they used on several occasions to impersonate such frightening characters as

Jud the Ineffable Vug
and Killmaster 18.
Needless to say, we did not fall for any of their high jinks.

entries.translation:
我想，我知道的唯一重大事 件和低等愚蠢的烏姆加有關
我們經常得忍受他們的惡作 劇。
至少我們已除掉那些煩人笑 話的一個來源——一具異常 強力的超波發射器
他們曾用它冒充許多嚇人的 角色，例如
行星吞噬者大宗師
不可言喻的伏格朱德
以及殺戮大師 18。
不用說，我們當然沒有上過 任何一次當。
事實上，我們成功從烏姆加 手中奪走了他們珍貴的發射 器，
終結了他們病態的搞笑企 圖。

entries.label: bye_friendly_space
entries.body: Goodbye, Spathi, I hope you remain well.
entries.source: Goodbye, Spathi, I hope you remain well.
entries.translation: 再見，斯帕西， 希望你平安無事。

entries.label: GOODBYE_FRIENDLY_SPACE
entries.body: Goodbye, Hunam, I hope you aren't eaten by monsters.
entries.source: Goodbye, Hunam, I hope you aren't eaten by monsters.
entries.translation: 再見，休南人， 希望你不會被怪物吃掉。

entries.label: looking_for_a_few_good_squids
entries.body: Let me be frank. We seek allies.
entries.source: Let me be frank. We seek allies.
entries.translation: 我就直說了。我們在尋找盟 友。

entries.label: URQUAN_SLAVES
entries.body:
In case you have not forgotten, we are bonded to the Ur-Quan as slaves.
The punishment for the plan you propose can be described as `Death'.
entries.source:
In case you have not forgotten, we are bonded to the Ur-Quan as slaves.
The punishment for the plan you propose can be described as `Death'.
entries.translation:
怕你忘了提醒一下， 我們是受烏爾關束縛的奴 隸。
你所提議計畫的懲罰， 可以用「死亡」兩字形容。

entries.label: why_slaves
entries.body: That brings up a good point. If you are such cowards, why do you fight for the Ur-Quan?
entries.source: That brings up a good point. If you are such cowards, why do you fight for the Ur-Quan?
entries.translation: 說得好。既然你們這麼膽 小，為什麼還替烏爾關作 戰？

entries.label: UMGAH_TRICK
entries.body:
This is a sad tale, so do not even try to contain your tears.
After the Ur-Quan demolished the Ilwrath, they turned the force of their Armada against us Spathi.
The term `rapidly subjugated' would best describe what happened next.
When the Ur-Quan arrived at Spathiwa, there was a great ceremony.
Part of that ceremony involved blasting portions of our planet's surface into radioactive dust
and this part we did not enjoy.
But the worst was yet to come.
Our leaders were called into the command chamber of Ur-Quan Lord 1's dreadnought
where they were read a long and complicated document explaining the choices given new slaves.
When our leaders heard the term `forever encased' and `impenetrable shield'
they grew over-excited, I'm afraid, and made a fatal error.
The decision was to be transmitted to the Ur-Quan via one of two rods, one colored black, the other white.
Our leader handed the white rod to one of the Ur-Quan's servants, signifying `Fallow Slavery',
but the servant somehow exchanged rods and handed the Ur-Quan Lord a black rod
indicating our desire to become fighting slaves!
By the time we learned of the switch, it was too late -- the Ur-Quan would not permit a change in status.
Following that most tragic day, we were forced to assume the role of an Ur-Quan star-thug.
We tried to avoid combat, but the Ur-Quan gave us three warnings, each more strident than the last.
When we learned that there would be no fourth warning, simply annihilation
we attended to our new role with improved vigor.
Oh, and perhaps you have already guessed -- the Ur-Quan's servant who made the switch
was an Umgah.

entries.translation:
這是個悲傷的故事， 所以你千萬別想忍住淚水。
烏爾關擊潰伊爾拉斯後， 便把艦隊兵鋒轉向我們斯帕 西。
「迅速遭到征服」最能形容 接下來發生的事。
烏爾關抵達斯帕西瓦時， 舉行了一場盛大典禮。
部分典禮內容， 是把我們行星的一部分地表 轟成放射性塵埃
這一段我們不太喜歡。
但最糟的還在後頭。
我們的領袖被召進烏爾關一 號領主無畏艦的指揮室
有人向他們宣讀一份又臭又 長的文件，說明新奴隸能做 的選擇。
我們的領袖聽見「永遠封 閉」和「無法穿透的護盾」 這些詞
恐怕興奮過頭， 犯下致命錯誤。
必須透過兩根棒子中的一根 把決定傳達給烏爾關， 一根黑色，另一根白色。
我們的領袖把白棒交給烏爾 關的一名僕從， 代表選擇「休耕奴役」，
但那名僕從不知怎麼調換了 棒子，交給烏爾關領主一根 黑棒
表示我們想成為戰奴！
等我們發現遭到掉包時， 一切都太遲了——烏爾關不 允許改變身分。
那個最悲慘的日子過後， 我們被迫扮演烏爾關星際惡 霸。
我們試圖避免戰鬥， 但烏爾關發出三次警告， 而且一次比一次嚴厲。
得知不會再有第四次警告， 只有徹底滅亡後
我們便以更充沛的幹勁履行 新職責。
喔，也許你已經猜到了—— 那個掉包的烏爾關僕從
正是烏姆加。

entries.label: tell_us_about_you
entries.body: What can you tell us of your species?
entries.source: What can you tell us of your species?
entries.translation: 你們能告訴我們哪些關於自 身物種的事？

entries.label: ABOUT_US
entries.body:
We can best be described as `Meta-Mollusks'
possessing the best qualities of both the clam and the Dravatz, which is not native to your world.
We are intelligent and clever, though you would never call us cunning.
Each day when we awaken we call forth the traditional Spathi prayer
`Oh God...Please don't let me die today! Tomorrow would be so much better!'

entries.translation:
最適合形容我們的是「後設 軟體動物」
同時擁有蛤蜊和 Dravatz 的最佳特質，後者並非你們 世界的原生物種。
我們聰明又機靈， 但你絕不會說我們詭計多 端。
每天醒來時，我們都會念出 斯帕西的傳統禱詞
`喔，神啊…… 求求您今天別讓我死！ 明天死會好得多！'

entries.label: what_you_really_want
entries.body: But what do you really want out of this great mystery called `Life'?
entries.source: But what do you really want out of this great mystery called `Life'?
entries.translation: 但你真正想從名為「生命」 的偉大謎團中得到什麼？

entries.label: WANT_THIS
entries.body:
I want to live forever, with no pain whatsoever, owning vast personal property plus a company of nubiles.
If this is in your power to give, I beg of you to do so.
entries.source:
I want to live forever, with no pain whatsoever, owning vast personal property plus a company of nubiles.
If this is in your power to give, I beg of you to do so.
entries.translation:
我想永遠活著， 完全不受任何痛苦， 擁有龐大私人財產， 外加一群青春尤物。
如果你有能力賜給我這些， 我求你務必照辦。

entries.label: how_about_alliance
entries.body: Under the circumstances, I think it would be best if you allied with Earth immediately.
entries.source: Under the circumstances, I think it would be best if you allied with Earth immediately.
entries.translation: 依目前情況，我認為你們最 好立刻與地球結盟。

entries.label: SURE
entries.body:
Sure, consider it done. Allies to the bitter end.
NOT!
entries.source:
Sure, consider it done. Allies to the bitter end.
NOT!
entries.translation:
當然，就當已經辦好了。 盟友至死不渝。
才怪！

entries.label: part_in_peace
entries.body: We leave as we came, in peace.
entries.source: We leave as we came, in peace.
entries.translation: 我們如來時一般， 和平離去。

entries.label: KEEP_IT_SECRET
entries.body:
Look, can we keep this as a secret between the two of us?
It's really rather embarrassing.
entries.source:
Look, can we keep this as a secret between the two of us?
It's really rather embarrassing.
entries.translation:
聽著，能不能把這件事當成 你我之間的祕密？
實在很丟臉。

entries.label: heard_youre_cowards
entries.body: We have heard that you are a race of cowards. Is this true?
entries.source: We have heard that you are a race of cowards. Is this true?
entries.translation: 我們聽說你們是個膽小鬼種 族。真的嗎？

entries.label: DARN_TOOTIN
entries.body:
Yes, absolutely, and with no qualifications.
This system has kept us alive for millenia, and we see no reason to change it now.
entries.source:
Yes, absolutely, and with no qualifications.
This system has kept us alive for millenia, and we see no reason to change it now.
entries.translation:
對，千真萬確，毫無保留。
這套制度讓我們活了好幾千 年，看不出現在有什麼理由 改變。

entries.label: wanna_fight
entries.body: Wanna fight?
entries.source: Wanna fight?
entries.translation: 想打架嗎？

entries.label: YES_WE_DO
entries.body: Er... Yeah, we do.
entries.source: Er... Yeah, we do.
entries.translation: 呃……想啊，我們想。

entries.label: so_lets_fight
entries.body: So let us fight.
entries.source: So let us fight.
entries.translation: 那就開戰吧。

entries.label: OK_LETS_FIGHT
entries.body: Okay, let's fight. Here we go. We're rarin' to fight.
entries.source: Okay, let's fight. Here we go. We're rarin' to fight.
entries.translation: 好，來打吧。要開始囉。 我們等不及要打了。

entries.label: so_lets_fight_already
entries.body: So let's fight, already!
entries.source: So let's fight, already!
entries.translation: 所以快點開打吧！

entries.label: DONT_REALLY_WANT_TO_FIGHT
entries.body:
Oh! Um... we changed our minds. We don't want to. Sorry.
(Pwappy, you idiot! I told you that wouldn't work!)
entries.source:
Oh! Um... we changed our minds. We don't want to. Sorry.
(Pwappy, you idiot! I told you that wouldn't work!)
entries.translation:
喔！呃……我們改變主意 了。我們不想打。抱歉。
（Pwappy， 你這白痴！我就說這招沒 用！）

entries.label: attack_you_now
entries.body: Evil squid -- Prepare to Die!
entries.source: Evil squid -- Prepare to Die!
entries.translation: 邪惡烏賊——準備受死吧！

entries.label: YIPES
entries.body:
I can't believe this!
Not only is the Hunam alien unreasonably hostile but he doesn't even know his biological analogs!
We are much more closely related to Earth clams and
what was that, Weapons Officer? His ship approaches with shields up and weapons armed...
Yipes!

真不敢相信！
休南外星人不只蠻橫無理地 充滿敵意，居然連生物相似 種都分不清楚！
我們和地球蛤蜊的親緣近得 多，而且
什麼事，武器官？ 他的船升起護盾、 武器就緒，正向我們接 近……
咿呀！

entries.label: whats_up_space_2
entries.body: Hi folks, what's new?
entries.source: Hi folks, what's new?
entries.translation: 嗨，各位，有什麼新鮮事？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_SPACE_2
entries.body:
Very little, I'm afraid. We've just been watching the stars.
You know, actually there was something that happened
last month on the 17th; we saw a new star appear between the Circini and Chandrasekhar star clusters.
We watched it and watched it -- for three days, we just watched it
Then it went away, vanished, just like that.
I hope it comes back.

entries.translation:
恐怕沒什麼。我們一直只是 在觀察星星。
你知道嗎，其實確實發生過 一件事
上個月 17 日，我們看到 Circini 與 Chandrasekhar 星團之間出現一顆新星。
我們一直看、一直看——整 整三天，就只是看著它
然後它消失了， 就那樣不見了。
希望它還會回來。

entries.label: give_us_info_from_space
entries.body: Allies, grant us the boon of your wisdom.
entries.source: Allies, grant us the boon of your wisdom.
entries.translation: 盟友啊，請賜予我們你們的 智慧。

entries.label: GET_INFO_FROM_SPATHIWA
entries.body:
Stuck as we are, here out in deep space, we learn little of interest.
I suggest you consult the more interesting folk at Spathiwa.
entries.source:
Stuck as we are, here out in deep space, we learn little of interest.
I suggest you consult the more interesting folk at Spathiwa.
entries.translation:
我們困在這片深空， 實在聽不到多少有趣消息。
我建議你去斯帕西瓦， 問問那些比較有意思的傢 伙。

entries.label: give_us_resources_space
entries.body: Please share your mineral wealth with us, as allies.
entries.source: Please share your mineral wealth with us, as allies.
entries.translation: 身為盟友，請與我們分享你 們的礦產財富。

entries.label: GET_RESOURCES_FROM_SPATHIWA
entries.body:
As you wish. Our waste recycling unit is at your disposal.
There you will find quantities of methane, sulfurous gas, and some interesting organic compounds.
Feel free, take all you want.
entries.source:
As you wish. Our waste recycling unit is at your disposal.
There you will find quantities of methane, sulfurous gas, and some interesting organic compounds.
Feel free, take all you want.
entries.translation:
如你所願。我們的廢棄物回 收裝置任你使用。
那裡有大量甲烷、 含硫氣體和一些有趣的有機 化合物。
別客氣，想拿多少就拿多 少。

entries.label: what_do_for_fun
entries.body: What do you guys do for fun out here in deep space?
entries.source: What do you guys do for fun out here in deep space?
entries.translation: 你們這些傢伙待在深空， 都玩些什麼消遣？

entries.label: DO_THIS_FOR_FUN
entries.body:
We used to be bored, but then we bought this cool entertainment product.
It simulated a grand adventure through a thousand parsecs of hostile space
where we met interesting aliens, uncovered the secrets of a long-lost superior race
and eventually, to save our world from destruction, we had to face the dread...
never mind, I can tell you aren't really interested.

entries.translation:
我們以前很無聊， 後來買了這款超酷的娛樂產 品。
它模擬一場穿越一千秒差距 敵對太空的壯闊冒險
途中會遇見有趣的外星人、 揭開一個失落已久之優越種 族的祕密
最後為了拯救世界免遭毀 滅，我們必須面對那恐怖 的……
算了，看得出來你根本沒興 趣。

entries.label: bye_ally_space
entries.body: Goodbye, Friend Spathi. I hope your journey is a safe one.
entries.source: Goodbye, Friend Spathi. I hope your journey is a safe one.
entries.translation: 再見，斯帕西朋友。 祝你一路平安。

entries.label: GOODBYE_ALLY_SPACE
entries.body: Same to you.
entries.source: Same to you.
entries.translation: 你也一樣。

entries.label: OK_WE_FIGHT_AT_PLUTO
entries.body:
My ichors pulse through my body with unusual ferocity!
Your arrogance has whipped me into a violent frenzy
and I am compelled to engage you in a preemptive-defensive action.
Now you shall never learn my important secrets
such as the location of the Orange Giant star around which my home planet orbits
oops -- dang! -- you made me give that away!
Captain, if you somehow survive my attack, I have one sincere hope
that you may soon be devoured slowly by an ugly, flat-toothed herbivore!

我的體液以異常凶猛之勢在 全身脈動！
你的傲慢把我煽動得狂暴不 已
迫使我對你採取先發制人的 防禦行動。
現在你永遠不會知道我的重 要祕密
例如我母星所繞行的那顆橙 色巨星位於何處
糟糕——可惡！ ——你害我說溜嘴了！
艦長，如果你不知怎麼活過 了我的攻擊，我有一個真誠 願望
願你很快被一隻扁牙醜陋的 草食動物慢慢吃掉！
